description: Change which events a webhook receives, or how Fillo authenticates to it. Sending `authentication` replaces the stored credential wholesale. The endpoint URL cannot be changed — remove the webhook and add the new URL, which also mints a fresh signing secret. At least one of includeAbandoned or authentication is required. Needs webhooks:manage.

authentication.description: How Fillo authenticates to your endpoint: {"type":"none"}, or {"type":"bearer"|"x-api-key","secret":"…"}. The secret is stored encrypted and never returned.

form.description: Form id or hosted slug. A stable push handle also resolves on a login token; a project API key takes the id or slug.

name: fillo_update_webhook
title: Update a form's webhook
